examples.english: My uncle is so garrulous that family dinners can last for hours.
examples.persian: عمویم آن‌قدر پرحرف است که شام‌های خانوادگی می‌تواند ساعت‌ها طول بکشد.

miniContext: My uncle is so garrulous that family dinners can last for hours.

examples.english: Being naturally gregarious, she made friends within minutes at the new office.
examples.persian: او که ذاتاً اجتماعی و معاشرتی است، در عرض چند دقیقه در دفتر جدید دوست پیدا کرد.

miniContext: Being naturally gregarious, she made friends within minutes at the new office.

examples.english: The fox escaped the trap through sheer guile rather than strength.
examples.persian: روباه با حیله‌گری محض، نه با زور، از تله فرار کرد.

miniContext: The fox escaped the trap through sheer guile rather than strength.

examples.english: The movie relied on hackneyed phrases like 'it's not you, it's me.'
examples.persian: آن فیلم به عبارت‌های کلیشه‌ای و تکراری مانند «مشکل تو نیستی، من هستم» تکیه داشت.

miniContext: The movie relied on hackneyed phrases like 'it's not you, it's me.'

examples.english: The coach's halftime harangue about effort left the players stunned.
examples.persian: سخنرانی تند و طولانی مربی درباره تلاش در نیمه بازی، بازیکنان را مبهوت کرد.

miniContext: The coach's halftime harangue about effort left the players stunned.

examples.english: He drove through the storm, heedless of the warnings on the radio.
examples.persian: او بی‌ملاحظه به هشدارهای رادیو، در میان طوفان رانندگی کرد.

miniContext: He drove through the storm, heedless of the warnings on the radio.

examples.english: The young designer became known as an iconoclast who rejected traditional fashion rules.
examples.persian: طراح جوان به‌عنوان سنت‌شکنی شناخته شد که قوانین سنتی مد را رد می‌کرد.

miniContext: The young designer became known as an iconoclast who rejected traditional fashion rules.

examples.english: The author's idiosyncratic use of punctuation makes her novels instantly recognizable.
examples.persian: استفاده منحصربه‌فرد و غیرمعمول نویسنده از علائم نگارشی، رمان‌هایش را فوراً قابل‌شناسایی می‌کند.

miniContext: The author's idiosyncratic use of punctuation makes her novels instantly recognizable.

examples.english: In mathematics, certain laws are treated as immutable truths.
examples.persian: در ریاضیات، برخی قوانین به‌عنوان حقایقی تغییرناپذیر در نظر گرفته می‌شوند.

miniContext: In mathematics, certain laws are treated as immutable truths.

examples.english: A good judge must remain impartial, no matter who is on trial.
examples.persian: یک قاضی خوب باید بی‌طرف بماند، فارغ از اینکه چه کسی محاکمه می‌شود.

miniContext: A good judge must remain impartial, no matter who is on trial.

examples.english: As an impecunious student, he survived mostly on rice and lentils.
examples.persian: او به‌عنوان دانشجویی بی‌پول، بیشتر با برنج و عدس زنده می‌ماند.

miniContext: As an impecunious student, he survived mostly on rice and lentils.

examples.english: The imperious queen demanded that her every wish be obeyed instantly.
examples.persian: ملکه خودکامه و آمرانه خواست که هر خواسته‌اش فوراً اجرا شود.

miniContext: The imperious queen demanded that her every wish be obeyed instantly.

examples.english: The reporter's impertinent question caught the minister off guard.
examples.persian: سؤال گستاخ و بی‌ادبانه خبرنگار، وزیر را غافلگیر کرد.

miniContext: The reporter's impertinent question caught the minister off guard.

examples.english: The two rival clans remained implacable enemies for generations.
examples.persian: آن دو طایفه رقیب برای نسل‌ها دشمنانی آشتی‌ناپذیر باقی ماندند.

miniContext: The two rival clans remained implacable enemies for generations.

examples.english: There was an implicit understanding that neither of them would mention the past.
examples.persian: یک توافق ضمنی و غیرمستقیم وجود داشت که هیچ‌کدام از آن دو درباره گذشته صحبت نکنند.

miniContext: There was an implicit understanding that neither of them would mention the past.

examples.english: Her inadvertent mention of the surprise party nearly ruined the plan.
examples.persian: اشاره ناخواسته و سهوی او به مهمانی سورپرایز، تقریباً نقشه را خراب کرد.

miniContext: Her inadvertent mention of the surprise party nearly ruined the plan.

examples.english: The politician's incendiary speech sparked protests across the city.
examples.persian: سخنرانی تحریک‌کننده و التهاب‌آفرین سیاستمدار، اعتراضاتی را در سراسر شهر برانگیخت.

miniContext: The politician's incendiary speech sparked protests across the city.

examples.english: Her incisive questions during the interview exposed the flaws in his plan.
examples.persian: سؤالات تیز و نافذ او در طول مصاحبه، نقص‌های نقشه او را برملا کرد.

miniContext: Her incisive questions during the interview exposed the flaws in his plan.

examples.english: A skyscraper would look incongruous next to the old stone cottages.
examples.persian: یک آسمان‌خراش در کنار آن کلبه‌های سنگی قدیمی، ناسازگار و نامتناسب به نظر می‌رسد.

miniContext: A skyscraper would look incongruous next to the old stone cottages.

examples.english: The indefatigable volunteers worked through the night to rebuild the shelter.
examples.persian: داوطلبان خستگی‌ناپذیر تمام شب کار کردند تا پناهگاه را بازسازی کنند.

miniContext: The indefatigable volunteers worked through the night to rebuild the shelter.

examples.english: She grew indignant when she was blamed for a mistake she hadn't made.
examples.persian: او وقتی به خاطر اشتباهی که مرتکب نشده بود مقصر شناخته شد، خشمگین از بی‌عدالتی شد.

miniContext: She grew indignant when she was blamed for a mistake she hadn't made.

examples.english: The indolent cat spent the entire afternoon sleeping in the sun.
examples.persian: آن گربه تنبل تمام بعدازظهر را در آفتاب خوابید.

miniContext: The indolent cat spent the entire afternoon sleeping in the sun.

examples.english: Watching the northern lights for the first time filled her with an ineffable joy.
examples.persian: تماشای شفق شمالی برای اولین بار، او را با شادی‌ای توصیف‌ناپذیر پر کرد.

miniContext: Watching the northern lights for the first time filled her with an ineffable joy.

examples.english: No system is truly infallible, no matter how carefully it is designed.
examples.persian: هیچ سیستمی واقعاً خطاناپذیر نیست، هر چقدر هم که با دقت طراحی شده باشد.

miniContext: No system is truly infallible, no matter how carefully it is designed.

examples.english: There is an inherent risk in investing in any new company.
examples.persian: سرمایه‌گذاری در هر شرکت جدیدی، خطری ذاتی دارد.

miniContext: There is an inherent risk in investing in any new company.

examples.english: Constant interruptions are inimical to deep, focused work.
examples.persian: وقفه‌های پیوسته برای کار عمیق و متمرکز، مخالف و زیان‌آور هستند.

miniContext: Constant interruptions are inimical to deep, focused work.

examples.english: Carbon monoxide poisoning is insidious because the gas has no smell or color.
examples.persian: مسمومیت با مونوکسید کربن موذیانه و پنهان است، چون این گاز بو و رنگی ندارد.

miniContext: Carbon monoxide poisoning is insidious because the gas has no smell or color.

examples.english: The soup was so insipid that she reached for the salt immediately.
examples.persian: آن سوپ آن‌قدر بی‌مزه و کسل‌کننده بود که او فوراً به سمت نمک رفت.

miniContext: The soup was so insipid that she reached for the salt immediately.

examples.english: The insolent remark from the new intern annoyed the entire team.
examples.persian: اظهار نظر گستاخانه کارآموز جدید، تمام تیم را آزار داد.

miniContext: The insolent remark from the new intern annoyed the entire team.

examples.english: The intrepid explorer crossed the frozen strait alone, without any backup.
examples.persian: آن کاشف بی‌باک به‌تنهایی و بدون هیچ پشتیبانی از آبراه یخ‌زده عبور کرد.

miniContext: The intrepid explorer crossed the frozen strait alone, without any backup.
